restatements.text: Prohibits people from demonstrating within 100 feet of the entrance to a house of worship while scheduled religious services are taking place.

findings.quote: No person may demonstrate within 100 feet of the entrance of a house of worship during scheduled religious services.
findings.mechanism: The clause explicitly restricts speech by banning demonstrations in specific public spaces at specific times.

findings.quote: No person may demonstrate within 100 feet of the entrance of a house of worship during scheduled religious services.
findings.mechanism: By removing demonstrations from the immediate entrance area, the clause protects congregants' ability to attend and conduct religious services without direct physical proximity to protests.

analysis.answer: Current law permits demonstrations on public sidewalks near houses of worship, limited only by general traffic and noise rules. This measure overrides that by banning demonstrations entirely within a 100-foot radius of the entrance during scheduled services.

Worshippers and religious institutions benefit from an undisturbed entrance area. Protesters, activists, and demonstrators bear the cost of losing access to public space close to their intended audience.

Demonstrators will likely relocate their activities just outside the 100-foot perimeter. Law enforcement will have to determine the boundaries and verify the timing of scheduled services when responding to complaints.

The measure addresses the problem of protests harassing, disturbing, or blocking people attending religious services. The 100-foot buffer mechanism physically separates demonstrators from the entrance, though it creates potential free-speech conflicts and relies on the public knowing when services are scheduled.
Law enforcement officers gain discretion in deciding what behaviors qualify as a "demonstration" and in enforcing the buffer zone.

flags.note: The term is undefined, leaving it unclear whether it includes silent protests, single individuals holding signs, leafleting, or only larger organized protests.
It is not specified how the schedule must be established or communicated to the public so that people know when the restriction is in effect.

items.text: Protection for worshippers from facing demonstrations within 100 feet of entrances while attending scheduled services.
The freedom to hold demonstrations on public spaces if they fall within 100 feet of a house of worship during a service.

changes.empty_reason: The measure does not affect any directional concerns.

items.text: The legal right to demonstrate on public sidewalks outside houses of worship without a specific buffer zone.
A guaranteed 100-foot demonstration-free buffer zone around the entrances of houses of worship during their services.
